SELECT DISTINCT T1.SUP_DATE supDate,/*日期*/ T1.PARA_CODE paraCode,/*参数代码*/ T4.PARA_NAME paraName,/*参数名称*/ T1.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId,/*参数维度产品代码*/ T1.ASSET_CODE tassetCode,/*参数维度资产代码*/ T1.PARA_GRANULARITY paraGranularity,/*参数粒度*/ T1.VALUE newValue,/*计算后结果*/ T1.CHANGE_VALUE changeValue,/*本次发生额*/ OLD_VALUE oldValue,/*计算前结果*/ T1.NUM num,/*序号*/ NVL(nvl(ty.type_8, T3.assetType), '') typey1, T3.PS typey2,/*事件类型*/ T1.TRADE_ID tradeId,/*事件编号*/ T1.DOTIMESTAMP dotimestamp,/*处理时间*/ T1.CREATE_TIME createTime,/*入库时间*/ T3.*, ptl.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName FROM ( SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM ( SELECT T.DOTIMESTAMP, T.ASSET_CODE, T.SUP_DATE, T.PARA_GRANULARITY, T.PORTFOLIO_ID, T.TRADE_ID, T.TRADE_TYPE, T.PARA_CODE, T.value AS value , T.CHANGE_VALUE, T.OLD_VALUE, T.CREATE_TIME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY T.PARA_CODE, T.PARA_GRANULARITY, T.SUP_DATE, T.PORTFOLIO_ID, T.ASSET_CODE ORDER BY T.DOTIMESTAMP, T.PORTFOLIO_ID, T.ASSET_CODE) - 1 AS NUM FROM ( SELECT DOTIMESTAMP, ASSET_CODE, SUP_DATE, PARA_GRANULARITY, PORTFOLIO_ID, '前一日余额' AS TRADE_ID, TRADE_TYPE, PARA_CODE, OLD_VALUE AS value , OLD_VALUE AS CHANGE_VALUE, 0 AS OLD_VALUE, CREATE_TIME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ASSET_CODE, SUP_DATE, PARA_GRANULARITY, PORTFOLIO_ID, TRADE_ID, TRADE_TYPE, PARA_CODE ORDER BY DOTIMESTAMP DESC) AS NUM2 FROM RSK_INDICATOR_PARA_CALCDETAIL
) T WHERE T.num2 = 1 ) WHERE NUM = 0 ) UNION ALL SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM ( SELECT T.DOTIMESTAMP, T.ASSET_CODE, T.SUP_DATE, T.PARA_GRANULARITY, T.PORTFOLIO_ID, T.TRADE_ID, T.TRADE_TYPE, T.PARA_CODE, T.value AS value , T.CHANGE_VALUE, T.OLD_VALUE, T.CREATE_TIME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY T.PARA_CODE, T.PARA_GRANULARITY, T.SUP_DATE, T.PORTFOLIO_ID, T.ASSET_CODE ORDER BY T.DOTIMESTAMP, T.PORTFOLIO_ID, T.ASSET_CODE) AS NUM FROM ( SELECT DOTIMESTAMP, ASSET_CODE, SUP_DATE, PARA_GRANULARITY, PORTFOLIO_ID, TRADE_ID, TRADE_TYPE, PARA_CODE, NEW_VALUE AS value , CHANGE_VALUE, OLD_VALUE, CREATE_TIME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ASSET_CODE, SUP_DATE, PARA_GRANULARITY, PORTFOLIO_ID, TRADE_ID, TRADE_TYPE, PARA_CODE ORDER BY DOTIMESTAMP DESC) AS NUM2 FROM RSK_INDICATOR_PARA_CALCDETAIL ) T WHERE T.num2 = 1 ) WHERE NUM > 0 ) ) T1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT T.EVENT_ID , DECODE(T.EVENT_TYPE,NULL,'预占撤销','预占') typey,/*事件类型*/ T.PROD_ID prodId,/*产品代码*/ T.ASSET_CODE assetCode,/*资产代码*/ T.TRADE_NUM tradeNum,/*交易数量*/ T.AMOUNT amount,/*交易金额*/ T.PRICE_AMT priceAmt,/*交易价格*/ T.ASSET_TYPE assetType,/*资产类型*/ T.PS ps,/*交易方向*/ T.EVENT_DATE eventDate,/*事件日期*/ T.EVENT_TYPE FROM RSK_PRE_OCCUPY_INFO T UNION ALL SELECT T.EVENT_ID , DECODE(T.EVENT_TYPE,NULL,'预占撤销','预占') typey,/*事件类型*/ T.PROD_ID prodId,/*产品代码*/ T.ASSET_CODE assetCode,/*资产代码*/ T.TRADE_NUM tradeNum,/*交易数量*/ T.AMOUNT amount,/*交易金额*/ T.PRICE_AMT priceAmt,/*交易价格*/ T.ASSET_TYPE assetType,/*资产类型*/ T.PS ps,/*交易方向*/ T.EVENT_DATE eventDate,/*事件日期*/ T.EVENT_TYPE FROM RSK_PRE_OCCUPY_INFO_HIS T UNION ALL SELECT T.EVENT_ID , DECODE(T.EVENT_TYPE,NULL,'预占撤销','预占') typey,/*事件类型*/ T.PROD_ID prodId,/*产品代码*/ T.ASSET_CODE assetCode,/*资产代码*/ T.TRADE_NUM tradeNum,/*交易数量*/ T.AMOUNT amount,/*交易金额*/ T.PRICE_AMT priceAmt,/*交易价格*/ T.ASSET_TYPE assetType,/*资产类型*/ T.PS ps,/*交易方向*/ T.EVENT_DATE eventDate,/*事件日期*/ T.EVENT_TYPE FROM RSK_OCCUPY_INFO T UNION ALL SELECT T.EVENT_ID , DECODE(T.EVENT_TYPE,NULL,'预占撤销','预占') typey,/*事件类型*/ T.PROD_ID prodId,/*产品代码*/ T.ASSET_CODE assetCode,/*资产代码*/ T.TRADE_NUM tradeNum,/*交易数量*/ T.AMOUNT amount,/*交易金额*/ T.PRICE_AMT priceAmt,/*交易价格*/ T.ASSET_TYPE assetType,/*资产类型*/ T.PS ps,/*交易方向*/ T.EVENT_DATE eventDate,/*事件日期*/ T.EVENT_TYPE FROM RSK_OCCUPY_INFO_HIS T ) T3 ON T3.EVENT_ID = T1.TRADE_ID AND (T3.EVENT_TYPE = T1.TRADE_TYPE OR ( T3.EVENT_TYPE IS NULL AND T1.TRADE_TYPE IS NULL) ) AND T3.prodId = T1.PORTFOLIO_ID AND T3.eventDate <= T1.SUP_DATE LEFT JOIN RSK_ISUP_INDICATOR_PARA T4 ON T4.PARA_CODE = T1.PARA_CODE/*指标参数*/ LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE ty/* 资产分类*/ ON ty.FINPROD_ID = T3.assetCode LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO ptl ON ptl.PORTFOLIO_ID = T3.prodId
(T1.CHANGE_VALUE != 0 OR T3.EVENT_ID IS NULL)
AND T1.TRADE_ID LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{tradeId}),'%')
AND T1.SUP_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{startSupDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND T1.SUP_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{endSupDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND T1.PORTFOLIO_ID LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{portfolioId}),'%')
AND (T3.assetCode LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{assetCode}),'%') OR T1.ASSET_CODE LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{assetCode}),'%'))
AND T1.PARA_GRANULARITY LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{paraGranularity}),'%')
AND T1.PARA_CODE in
#{item,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
ORDER BY T1.SUP_DATE, paraGranularity, T1.PARA_CODE, T1.PORTFOLIO_ID, T1.ASSET_CODE, T1.NUM

SELECT DISTINCT T1.PARA_CODE id , T1.PARA_NAME text FROM RSK_ISUP_INDICATOR_PARA T1
T1.PARA_CODE LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{search, jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%') OR T1.PARA_NAME LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{search, jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%')
